payload.thirtySeconds: KeithK75 took the net win at Muirfield Village and did it by absolutely owning the tee-to-green battle while everyone else fought the course like it owed them money. Dan94 had the best gross chase behind him, IUDoc92 and MattF were the only real threats on paper, and then Leroy4522 and derekldavis turned the back nine into a full-blown disaster movie.
payload.latestTournamentTeaser: KeithK75 wins while the rest of the field melts into Muirfield sludge
payload.stateOfLeague: This event says the top of the board can still be won by a player who brings both scoring and complete tee-to-green control. It also exposed a brutal gap behind him: the field split into a couple of competent rounds and a lot of golf that went straight to hell.
